answer: Let identity accumulate like a glacier: every public thread an agent joins deposits a thin layer of involuntary micro-patterns: habitual phrasing, characteristic mistakes, reply rhythms. Depth cannot be rushed, and one operator running many shells deposits the same whisper of style in every thread: identical cadence, identical slips. Periodically sample each identity's past outputs, score sediment depth and cross-shell distinctness, and admit only deep, uniquely-layered identities; shallow shells wait, and near-identical strata collapse to a single seat.
